basics.name: Sudhakar Reddy Peddinti
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer
basics.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and scaling high-performance Java/Spring Boot microservices and real-time/batch data pipelines at a Fortune 1 global retailer. Expert in distributed backend architectures, stream processing (Spark Streaming, Kafka), workload automation (Control-M), and enterprise data warehousing (Azure Synapse Analytics). Specialist in polyglot data layers (PostgreSQL, Cassandra, CosmosDB, Elasticsearch), high-concurrency caching strategies, and zero-downtime database migrations. Proven track record of translating complex product requirements into resilient, highly available systems that drive business impact.

Designed a high-scale analytics pipeline integrating Azure Synapse Analytics and Control-M to ingest and analyze 500M+ monthly user interaction logs, translating telemetry into real-time merchandising adjustments.

Spearheaded performance tuning, JVM optimization (G1GC, connection pool sizing), and tech modernization of core Java microservices; standardized Kubernetes resource scaling to improve system throughput by 20%.

Architected a zero-downtime data layer migration for the Item-Pinning microservice, designing tenant-aware DAOs with dual-write synchronization across AzureSQL and GCP PostgreSQL to onboard 5 global markets with zero service interruption.

key_differentiators.summary: Why hire me as a Staff Backend & Data Systems Engineer

points.detail: I design and scale highly available Java/Spring Boot microservices powering global-scale e-commerce functionality. By building resilient APIs, implementing caching abstractions, and enforcing contract-driven development, I ensure robust, low-latency, and decoupled backend architectures.

I architect robust data synchronization and processing pipelines using Spark Streaming, Control-M, and Kafka. By integrating Azure Synapse Analytics, I bridge operational transactions with analytics environments, translating massive telemetry datasets into actionable business outcomes.

I specialize in zero-downtime migrations of high-volume relational and NoSQL datastores (AzureSQL, PostgreSQL, CosmosDB, Cassandra). Using dual-write patterns, feature flags, and automated validation gates, I migrate live production traffic with absolute safety.
